Brother '''Xando''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] of the [[Norclu Order]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Xando and his sect were on a pilgrimage to their holy planet [[Norclune]] and searched for a pilot in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] who could take them there. The order approached [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], but the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] declined when he learned that the pilgrims had no possessions to pay him for the trip.
